// Invoke unchanged pinned REST quota collectors through an isolated transport.
package quota

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha1"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/Azure/azqr/internal/az"
	"github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore"
	"github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-go/sdk/azcore/policy"
)

type quotaCaptureCredential struct{ t *testing.T }

func (c quotaCaptureCredential) GetToken(_ context.Context, o policy.TokenRequestOptions) (azcore.AccessToken, error) {
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(o.Scopes, []string{"https://management.azure.com/.default"}) {
		c.t.Fatal("unexpected synthetic audience")
	}
	return azcore.AccessToken{Token: "synthetic-quota-canary", ExpiresOn: time.Now().Add(time.Hour)}, nil
}

type quotaCapturePage struct {
	Status int
	Body   string
}
type quotaCaptureCase struct {
	Provider  string
	Pages     []quotaCapturePage
	Cancelled bool
}
type quotaCaptureResult struct {
	Entries  []UsageEntry
	Risk     []string
	Failed   bool
	Requests []string
}
type quotaCaptureTransport struct {
	t        *testing.T
	urls     []string
	pages    []quotaCapturePage
	requests []string
}

func (s *quotaCaptureTransport) Do(r *http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	i := len(s.requests)
	if i >= len(s.urls) || r.URL.String() != s.urls[i] || r.Method != "GET" || r.Body != nil || r.Header.Get("Authorization") != "Bearer synthetic-quota-canary" {
		s.t.Fatal("unexpected synthetic quota request", r.Method, r.URL.String())
	}
	s.requests = append(s.requests, r.URL.String())
	p := s.pages[i]
	return &http.Response{StatusCode: p.Status, Header: http.Header{"Content-Type": []string{"application/json"}}, Body: io.NopCloser(strings.NewReader(p.Body)), Request: r}, nil
}

type quotaCaptureNetworkTripwire struct{}

func (quotaCaptureNetworkTripwire) RoundTrip(*http.Request) (*http.Response, error) {
	panic("quota capture attempted real network")
}

func TestRegionQuotaCapture(t *testing.T) {
	output := os.Getenv("REGION_QUOTA_CAPTURE_OUTPUT")
	if output == "" {
		t.Fatal("missing capture output")
	}
	oldTransport, oldClient := http.DefaultTransport, http.DefaultClient
	http.DefaultTransport = quotaCaptureNetworkTripwire{}
	http.DefaultClient = &http.Client{Transport: quotaCaptureNetworkTripwire{}}
	defer func() { http.DefaultTransport, http.DefaultClient = oldTransport, oldClient }()
	blobs := map[string]string{"quota.go": "9d98d3d2c221b925fd5b4bbde4ddf78476146491", "appservice.go": "60ce83c4d2e7dbed133d1ac1389f9094ee1d39c9", "network.go": "8dd5eaa925f65388c966b1f4d22b9c13442828e5", "sql.go": "33d990e8016b9ee6a8088a203cb3a365bc69f357", "storage.go": "62e898c9492a62bb96eef115f5ea352d0918983b", "../../../../az/http_client.go": "05d85c5a50ee81f088731160020a914af83e1ca5"}
	for path, want := range blobs {
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		h := sha1.Sum(append([]byte(fmt.Sprintf("blob %d\x00", len(raw))), raw...))
		if fmt.Sprintf("%x", h) != want {
			t.Fatal("source blob changed", path)
		}
	}
	one := func(body string) []quotaCapturePage { return []quotaCapturePage{{200, body}} }
	row := func(name string, current, limit int) string {
		return fmt.Sprintf(`{"name":%q,"currentValue":%d,"limit":%d}`, name, current, limit)
	}
	envelope := func(rows ...string) string { return `{"value":[` + strings.Join(rows, ",") + `]}` }
	cases := map[string]quotaCaptureCase{
		"arithmetic":     {Provider: "Web", Pages: one(envelope(row("exact15", 85, 100), row("below15", 86, 100), row("at", 100, 100), row("over", 110, 100), row("negative", -5, 100), row("zero-limit", 1, 0), row("negative-limit", 1, -1)))},
		"names":          {Provider: "Sql", Pages: one(`{"value":[{"name":{"value":"Servers","localizedValue":"SQL Servers"},"currentValue":9,"limit":10},{"name":"ElasticPools","currentValue":1,"limit":10},{"name":null,"currentValue":1,"limit":10}]}`)},
		"empty":          {Provider: "Web", Pages: one(envelope())},
		"web-filter":     {Provider: "Web", Pages: one(envelope(row("CustomDomains", 1, 10), row("HostNameBindings", 1, 10), row("SslBindings", 1, 10), row("SslConnections", 1, 10), row("Certificates", 1, 10), row("customdomains", 1, 10), row("Workers", 1, 10)))},
		"network-filter": {Provider: "Network", Pages: one(envelope(row("NetworkWatchers", 1, 10), row("RouteFilterRulesPerRouteFilter", 1, 10), row("RouteFiltersPerExpressRouteBgpPeering", 1, 10), row("RoutesPerExpressRouteCircuit", 1, 10), row("BgpCommunityFilterRulesPerRouteFilter", 1, 10), row("networkwatchers", 1, 10), row("PublicIPAddresses", 1, 10)))},
		"storage-filter": {Provider: "Storage", Pages: one(envelope(row("TotalBlobContainers", 1, 10), row("TotalBlobs", 1, 10), row("TotalContainers", 1, 10), row("TotalFileShares", 1, 10), row("TotalQueues", 1, 10), row("TotalTables", 1, 10), row("totalblobs", 1, 10), row("StorageAccounts", 1, 10)))},
		"sql-filter":     {Provider: "Sql", Pages: one(envelope(row("DTUsPerServer", 1, 10), row("vCoresPerDatabase", 1, 10), row("dtusPerserver", 1, 10), row("Servers", 1, 10)))},
		"malformed":      {Provider: "Web", Pages: one(`{"value":`)},
		"invalid-name":   {Provider: "Web", Pages: one(`{"value":[{"name":42,"currentValue":1,"limit":10}]}`)},
		"cancelled":      {Provider: "Web", Pages: one(envelope()), Cancelled: true},
	}
	for _, status := range []int{400, 404, 405, 403} {
		p := quotaCapturePage{status, `{"error":{"code":"SyntheticQuotaError","message":"synthetic"}}`}
		cases[fmt.Sprintf("http%d", status)] = quotaCaptureCase{Provider: "Web", Pages: []quotaCapturePage{p}}
		cases[fmt.Sprintf("later-http%d", status)] = quotaCaptureCase{Provider: "Web", Pages: []quotaCapturePage{{200, ""}, p}}
	}
	cases["paged"] = quotaCaptureCase{Provider: "Web", Pages: []quotaCapturePage{{200, ""}, {200, envelope(row("second", 9, 10))}}}
	cases["later-malformed"] = quotaCaptureCase{Provider: "Web", Pages: []quotaCapturePage{{200, ""}, {200, `{"value":`}}}
	results := map[string]quotaCaptureResult{}
	const subscription = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
	versions := map[string]string{"Web": "2023-01-01", "Network": "2022-07-01", "Storage": "2023-01-01", "Sql": "2021-11-01"}
	for name, fixture := range cases {
		start := "https://management.azure.com/subscriptions/" + subscription + "/providers/Microsoft." + fixture.Provider + "/locations/eastus/usages?api-version=" + versions[fixture.Provider]
		urls := []string{start}
		if len(fixture.Pages) == 2 {
			next := start + "&$skiptoken=synthetic-second"
			urls = append(urls, next)
			fixture.Pages[0].Body = `{"value":[` + row("first", 1, 10) + `],"nextLink":` + fmt.Sprintf("%q", next) + `}`
			cases[name] = fixture
		}
		transport := &quotaCaptureTransport{t: t, urls: urls, pages: fixture.Pages, requests: []string{}}
		client := az.NewHttpClient(quotaCaptureCredential{t}, &az.HttpClientOptions{MaxRetries: -1, Timeout: time.Second, Scope: "https://management.azure.com/.default", Transport: transport})
		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		if fixture.Cancelled {
			cancel()
		}
		var entries []UsageEntry
		var err error
		switch fixture.Provider {
		case "Web":
			entries, err = FetchAppServiceQuota(ctx, client, subscription, "eastus")
		case "Network":
			entries, err = FetchNetworkQuota(ctx, client, subscription, "eastus")
		case "Storage":
			entries, err = FetchStorageQuota(ctx, client, subscription, "eastus")
		case "Sql":
			entries, err = FetchSQLQuota(ctx, client, subscription, "eastus")
		default:
			t.Fatal("unknown synthetic provider")
		}
		cancel()
		expected := len(urls)
		if fixture.Cancelled {
			expected = 0
		}
		if len(transport.requests) != expected {
			t.Fatal("source request sequence incomplete", name)
		}
		results[name] = quotaCaptureResult{Entries: entries, Risk: AtRiskSummaries(entries), Failed: err != nil, Requests: transport.requests}
	}
	write := func(name string, v any) {
		raw, err := json.MarshalIndent(v, "", "  ")
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err = os.MkdirAll(output, 0700); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err = os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(output, name), append(raw, '\n'), 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	write("source-quota-inputs.json", struct {
		Blobs map[string]string
		Cases map[string]quotaCaptureCase
	}{blobs, cases})
	write("source-quota-outputs.json", results)
}
